glosses: sich oder etwas zur Verfügung bereithalten

examples.text: Die nächsten Tage werden die Helfer auf jeden Fall weiter bereitstehen.

glosses: für eine Verwendung bereitgestellt worden sein

examples.text: Auf Gleis 10 steht für Sie bereit ICE 71 zur Weiterfahrt nach Hamburg-Altona.
Die Daten stehen auf dem vereinbarten Server zur Abholung bereit!

translations.source_sense_description: sich oder etwas zur Verfügung bereithalten

glosses: To wait in expectation of some event; to be ready.

examples.text: Please stand by for more instructions.

It had been his intention to go to Wimbledon, but as he himself said: “Why be blooming well frizzled when you can hear all the results over the wireless.[…]You stand by, Janet, and wake me up if they do any of that running commentary stuff.”

glosses: To remain loyal or faithful to.

examples.text: Even though money is scarce sometimes, Ann stands by her decision to be a full-time mother.

[W]hen a Hamas spokesman recently stood by his statement that Jews used the blood of non-Jewish children for their matzos – one of the oldest anti-Semitic canards around – European elites were largely silent.

glosses: To support; to continue to support despite things being bad.

examples.text: They stood by us all along and it's awesome to see them out here to support us today.

glosses: To do nothing. To be inactive in a situation.

examples.text: I can't simply stand by and watch you ruin your life.
